subject: GlidePath pilot runway — request for short extension + credits
messages:
From: Ethan Morales <ethan@glidepath.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@glidepath.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot update — blocker and request

Hi Soojin,

Quick update from our side: we hit an unexpected connector regression while wiring the GlidePath ingestion pipeline into your SDK. The root cause is a protobuf mismatch in our internal adapter that will require a focused fix from our eng team — they estimate 2–3 weeks to stabilize, not the 3–5 days we initially budgeted.

This means our pilot demo window is at risk and the engineers need extra runway to finish the adapter, plus an environment to validate end-to-end without token pressure. Would Redwood consider a 30-day trial extension and a one-time credit to cover testing/QA usage? We were thinking $5k in free credits to keep our evaluation moving while our SRE/ENG complete the fix.

We want to keep momentum and plan the customer-facing demo for mid-April, but we can only commit to dates once the adapter is green. Appreciate any flexibility.

Attaching an anonymized excerpt of the adapter logs so your team can see the failure pattern.

Thanks,
Ethan
Product Lead, GlidePath Solutions
[Attachment: integration-log.txt (text/plain, 78 KB)]
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan@glidepath.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot update — blocker and request

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the adapter regression.

We can absolutely discuss an extension and a top-up. Before I commit to numbers to your team, I need a quick internal alignment on approvals and a short milestone we can tie the extension to (so we have a clear success path).

Requesting: 1) Can you confirm the expected demo target date (best case / worst case)? 2) Can you share the SRE contact who will be validating once the fix is merged?

I'm looping Naomi for technical intake and Ben for commercial approval — I’ll come back with a proposed offer by EOD tomorrow. If anything changes on your timeline please flag it here.

— Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: GlidePath pilot — request for credits + 30d extension (GP-2028-PILOT-47)

Team — quick summary for approval: GlidePath (prospect) hit an unexpected engineering regression in their adapter. They’re asking for a 30-day trial extension and $5k in free credits to validate the fix and run e2e tests. Their goal is to keep the mid-April demo window.

Rationale: high strategic fit (embedding/connectors use case), strong signals in product evals, likely expansion if demo goes well. Risk: credits consumed without demo; can mitigate with milestone gating and billing contact capture.

Ask: approve up to $5k credit + 30-day extension, conditional on: 1) target demo date confirmed, 2) SRE contact for validation, 3) GlidePath agrees to provide weekly progress notes in-thread.

Attaching an internal one-pager with the timeline and recommended gating language.

[Attachment: internal-approval-summary.txt]

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: GlidePath pilot — request for credits + 30d extension (GP-2028-PILOT-47)

Soojin — thanks for the write-up. I’m comfortable supporting an accommodation but recommend a smaller top-up and a shorter extension to reduce credit exposure.

Approved: $3,000 one-time credit + 15 additional trial days.
Conditions: 1) confirm target demo date (hard date), 2) add billing contact (Marissa or billing team) on the acceptance email, 3) if the demo slips beyond the 15 days we’ll review for a second discretionary top-up but will require a short technical readout.

Please proceed with that offer and loop legal/procurement only if they accept.

Ben
VP, Global Accounts
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan@glidepath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot update — blocker and request

Ethan — thanks for your patience. Ben approved a discretionary accommodation: 3,000 USD in one-time credits plus a 15-day extension to your current trial window.

We’ll apply the credits to your pilot account immediately upon acceptance. Next steps:
- Confirm a hard demo target date (best/worst case) — we propose Apr 15 as the target, Apr 22 as fallback.
- Provide the SRE/eng validation contact so we can monitor e2e signoffs (this helps us avoid unnecessary top-ups).
- Add Marissa (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) to the billing thread for the proforma and DocuSign amendment.

If that looks OK, I’ll send a short amendment (DocuSign) and a proforma PDF for accounting.

Link: [DocuSign amendment (pilot extension) — docusign-pilot-amendment.link]
Attachment: proforma-invoice.pdf

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ethan Morales <ethan@glidepath.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Asha Kapoor <asha.kapoor@glidepath.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2028 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot update — blocker and request

Soojin / team — appreciate the quick turn. We accept the $3k credit + 15-day extension.

Confirmed demo target: Apr 15 (best case), Apr 22 (fallback). Our SRE for validation is Asha Kapoor (asha.kapoor@glidepath.ai) — she’ll ping Naomi once the adapter build is merged.

Please send the DocuSign and proforma; Marissa, copying you to add billing details for the invoice. Also attaching our SSO cert for your security team to pre-load in the sandbox once you’re ready.

Thanks again — we’ll keep the weekly updates as agreed.

Best,
Ethan
Product Lead, GlidePath Solutions
[Attachment: sso-certificate.pem (1.2 KB)]
